plugins.name: code-modernization
plugins.description: Modernize legacy codebases (COBOL, legacy Java/C++/.NET, monolith web apps) with a structured preflight / assess / map / extract-rules / brief / (reimagine | transform | uplift) / harden / status workflow. Cross-stack rewrites, greenfield reimagining, and same-stack version uplifts (e.g. .NET Framework → .NET 8); an interactive topology viewer; specialist agents; and optional dynamic-workflow orchestration with adversarial verification.

commands.name: modernize-assess
commands.description: Full discovery & portfolio analysis of a legacy system — inventory, complexity, debt, relative scale

commands.name: modernize-brief
commands.description: Generate a phased Modernization Brief — the approved plan that transformation agents will execute against

commands.name: modernize-extract-rules
commands.description: Mine business logic from legacy code into testable, human-readable rule specifications
headings: Method A — Workflow orchestration (preferred when available)

commands.name: modernize-harden
commands.description: Security vulnerability scan with a reviewable remediation patch — OWASP, CWE, CVE, secrets, injection

commands.name: modernize-map
commands.description: Dependency & topology mapping — call graphs, data lineage, batch flows, rendered as navigable diagrams
headings: topology.json is derived from UNTRUSTED source (node names come from filenames,
observations/flows from analyzed code). The data is injected into a <script>
block, and the HTML parser closes <script> on the literal bytes "</script>"
regardless of JS string context — so a node named "x</script><script>…" would
execute. json.dumps does NOT escape "<". Escape it (JSON-safe) to kill the breakout.

commands.name: modernize-preflight
commands.description: Environment readiness check — analysis tools, build toolchain, source completeness, telemetry access
headings: Check 0 — Ask the human (these answers are not in the source)
Check 3 — Build toolchain (prove it on THIS codebase, not just presence)
Check 6 — Scope boundary (is `$1` the whole world, or a slice of one?)

commands.name: modernize-reimagine
commands.description: Multi-agent greenfield rebuild — extract specs from legacy, design AI-native, scaffold & validate with HITL
headings: Phase C — Architecture (single agent, then critique)

commands.name: modernize-status
commands.description: Where am I in the modernization workflow — artifact inventory, staleness, secrets hygiene, next step

commands.name: modernize-transform
commands.description: Transform one legacy module to the target stack — idiomatic rewrite with behavior-equivalence tests
headings: Step 0a — Toolchain check (fail fast on target, adapt on legacy)

commands.name: modernize-uplift
commands.description: Same-stack version uplift (e.g. .NET Framework 4.8 → .NET 8) — preserve the code, fix the version deltas, prove equivalence by running one test suite on both runtimes
headings: Step 1 — Working copy, project graph & ordering
Step 4 — Dual-target test harness (establish BEFORE touching code)
Step 5 — Migrate: pilot ONE unit, then fan out in batches
5a — Pilot (mandatory; do it yourself, in-session, never in a workflow)
5b — Fan out in dependency-aware escalating batches
